summary: Two independent problems are running at once. (1) The token-cost alert and slowness come from an orchestrator agent loop: sessions repeat the get_holdings tool call x38 and abort. llm-gateway tokens_per_min rose from about 42k to 400000.0 starting in the 10:50 bucket and has stayed pinned there. (2) The blank notifications come from msg-delivery. Its 11:24 'notification template refactor' deploy is followed by 'template render failed: missing variable portfolio_value', and the service then sends notifications with an empty body. The trigger for the get_holdings loop is not identified, and I did not inspect portfolio-svc. The 10:33 orchestrator deploy is only described as a log level tweak, so it is a weak candidate.

hypotheses.statement: The orchestrator agent loop (repeated get_holdings calls, x38 per session) multiplies LLM calls through llm-gateway. This drives the token-cost alert and the slowness. The trigger for the loop is unknown.
hypotheses.label: medium

supporting.text: llm-gateway token throughput was flat near 42k/min until 10:40, then rose in the 10:50 bucket
Orchestrator sessions are looping on get_holdings; the same error repeats continuously from 10:55

hypotheses.statement: The msg-delivery 11:24 template refactor dropped or renamed the portfolio_value variable. Renders fail and notifications go out with an empty body. This is independent of the token problem.
hypotheses.label: medium

unresolved: What triggered the get_holdings loop (portfolio-svc behavior, tool or prompt change, or the orchestrator 10:33 deploy)? portfolio-svc was not inspected.
Is the 400000.0 tokens_per_min value a hard cap? True demand is unknown.
The orchestrator log results are truncated (180 total errors), and the query only covered 08:00 to 11:40.
Whether the blank notifications also depend on the upstream portfolio data path (the loop) or only on the msg-delivery template change was not tested.

actions.text: Roll back msg-delivery-00290, or hotfix the template so portfolio_value is supplied or has a default. Stop sending notifications with an empty body.
actions.rationale: The render failures began right after the deploy and are the direct source of the blank notifications.

actions.text: Cap per-session tool-call repetition in orchestrator (a hard limit well below 38). Apply a per-session token budget, and consider rate-limiting or temporarily disabling the get_holdings tool path.
actions.rationale: This stops the runaway LLM spend while the trigger is being found.

actions.text: Find why get_holdings loops. Check portfolio-svc responses to get_holdings, the tool schema or prompt, and recent flag or config changes. Test whether orchestrator-00508 is involved.
actions.rationale: The loop trigger is not identified, and portfolio-svc was not inspected.

actions.text: Replay or reconcile the empty-body notifications already sent, and check the outbound-msgs redelivery backlog.
actions.rationale: Users already received blank messages, and the logs show redelivery on outbound-msgs.

actions.text: Confirm the llm-gateway token quota or ceiling and add cost alerts on tokens_per_min growth.
actions.rationale: Throughput is pinned at 400000.0, so actual demand may be hidden.
